comparison.title: List Comparison
comparison.setupHint: Go to <myDeck>My Deck</myDeck> and set your archetype slug (e.g. <slug>n-zoroark</slug>) to compare your list against tournament results.
comparison.compareHint: Click "Compare" to analyze your list against tournament-winning <slug>{{slug}}</slug> lists from Limitless TCG.
comparison.noAdds: None — your deck covers the high-freq cards.
comparison.noAdjustments: Counts look good across high-freq cards.

errors.noListsFound: No public decklists found for "{{slug}}". Try the Limitless slug format (e.g. "n-zoroark", "dragapult-ex", "alakazam-dudunsparce").

version.reasoningImproving: "{{bestLabel}}" → {{bestWr}}% WR ({{bestGames}}). "{{worstLabel}}" → {{worstWr}}% WR ({{worstGames}}). Current changes appear positive.
version.reasoningDeclining: "{{bestLabel}}" → {{bestWr}}% WR ({{bestGames}}). "{{worstLabel}}" → {{worstWr}}% WR ({{worstGames}}). Your latest changes may have hurt this matchup.

tech.localNote: This is a key local matchup.
tech.dataHint: Rather than a guessed tech card: use the List Comparison to line your list up against the most successful lists of your own archetype (deck-fit-safe, same shell) — so you see, from data, which cards top pilots run that you're missing.

zeroWin.reasoning: 0 wins in {{games}} vs {{archetype}} ({{metaPct}}% meta). Highest-priority gap.
zeroWin.reasoningLocal: 0 wins in {{games}} vs {{archetype}} ({{metaPct}}% meta, local priority). Highest-priority gap.

localBlindspot.reasoning: {{archetype}} is in your local meta but you have no logged games. Track this matchup to get targeted recommendations.

bossMissing.reasoning: Gust effect is a staple. Missing it limits ability to take prizes around tanky benched Pokémon.

bossCount.reasoning: Single copy is inconsistent. Two copies is the competitive standard.

ballSearch.suggestion: Add Pokémon search (Ultra Ball / Nest Ball / Buddy-Buddy Poffin)
ballSearch.reasoning: No Pokémon search detected. These are critical for consistent setup.

overallDecline.suggestion: Overall WR dropped: {{bestWr}}% → {{currentWr}}% vs best version
overallDecline.reasoning: "{{bestLabel}}" averaged {{bestWr}}% WR ({{bestGames}}). Current "{{currentLabel}}" averaging {{currentWr}}% WR ({{currentGames}}). Consider reverting.

blindspot.reasoning: No logged games vs {{archetype}}. With {{metaPct}}% meta presence, you'll likely face it.

dataSparse.suggestion: Log more matches for better recommendations
dataSparse.reasoning_one: Only {{count}} game logged. Recommendations improve significantly with 10+ games.
dataSparse.reasoning_other: Only {{count}} games logged. Recommendations improve significantly with 10+ games.

lowPlayRate.suggestion: Consider removing "{{card}}" (only played in {{playRate}}% of games)
lowPlayRate.reasoning: Played in {{played}} out of {{total}} logged games. Low play rate suggests inconsistency or low relevance.

winRateDrag.suggestion: "{{card}}" has low WR when played ({{cardWr}}% vs. {{overallWr}}% overall)
winRateDrag.reasoning: In {{games}} games with this card: {{wins}}W/{{losses}}L ({{cardWr}}% WR). {{delta}}% below your overall WR. May indicate tempo loss caused by this card.

turn1Consistency.reasoning_one: Your first turn averages only {{actions}} actions across {{count}} logged game. Consider more draw supporters or search cards for a more reliable opening.
turn1Consistency.reasoning_other: Your first turn averages only {{actions}} actions across {{count}} logged games. Consider more draw supporters or search cards for a more reliable opening.

brickRate.reasoning: {{rate}}% of your turns had ≤1 action. This suggests frequent hand problems — more consistency cards may help.

prizeDominated.suggestion: Avg only {{prizes}} prizes taken in losses
prizeDominated.reasoning: In your {{count}} logged losses you take very few prizes on average. This points to a fundamental early-game weakness. Review your setup Pokémon and tempo attackers.

tempoGap.suggestion: Tempo weakness: wins avg {{winTurns}} turns, losses avg {{lossTurns}} turns
tempoGap.reasoning: You are losing significantly faster than you win. Often a sign of missing early disruption or too-slow attackers. Review your turns 1–3 game plan.
